description: Japan Airlines (JAL Mileage Bank): the flight miles, Mile-Up Bonus and FLY ON Points a JAL-operated itinerary earns. Flight miles = distance x class rate (30% to 150%; a Japan domestic sector on an international ticket uses its own table). FLY ON Points = flight miles x 2 within Japan, x 1.5 between Japan and Asia, Oceania or Vladivostok (cwsi.net's reading; JAL publishes no country list), x 1 otherwise, plus a 400-point flight bonus in most classes. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them), the ISO country codes of its two airports, and from/to IATA airport codes (needed to spot Vladivostok, VVO, which shares RU with the rest of Russia). Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. F = F (First 150%); A = A (First 150%); J = J (Business 125%); C = C (Business 125%); D = D (Business 125%); I = I (Business 125%); X = X (Business 70%); W = W (Premium Economy 100%); R = R (Premium Economy 100%); E = E (Premium Economy 70%); Y = Y (100%); B = B (100%); H = H (70%); K = K (70%); M = M (70%); L = L (50%); V = V (50%); S = S (50%); O = O (30%); Z = Z (30%); G = G (30%); Q = Q (30%); N = N (30%). The letter on your ticket. Japan domestic flights on the same ticket earn on JAL's domestic sector table, which uses other rates.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Japan Airlines's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fop.description: FLY ON Points you have this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next level.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your JAL level. NO = None; JG = JAL Global Club (+35%); CR = Crystal (+55%); SA = Sapphire (+105%); JP = JGC Premier (+105%); DI = Diamond (+130%). Sets the Mile-Up Bonus on flight miles. It does not add FLY ON Points.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
